newsitem.title: BELGIUM: FLORIDIENNE EXPANDS, SEES HIGHER 96 PROFIT.
newsitem.headline: FLORIDIENNE EXPANDS, SEES HIGHER 96 PROFIT.

text.p: Belgian holding company Floridienne SA said in an interim earnings statement it expected full year 1996 profit to rise and that it had expanded its agri-food and metals interests.
"The second half has started well, such that consolidated results for the end of the year should be higher than 1995's (group net) 90 million Belgian francs," Floridienne said.
It said it had also acquired two new food companies on the Indian Ocean islands of Reunion and Madagascar and bought five percent of Spanish metals recycling company Tratemiento Termico de Aguas SA.
"These investments form part of Floridienne's ongoing search for opportunities and do not represent, at this stage, a high amount," the company said.

Floridienne said it had acquired 100 percent of food companies Comidis and Sopral, which specialise in producing spices, to develop new niche agricultural products alongside its existing interests in farming edible snails.

Floridienne said losses in its agri-foods businesses widened to 33.5 from 30.1 million francs in the six months to June 30, but it predicted the division's full-year performance would show a "clear improvement" over 1995.
